pages.text: The $(item)Marked Spectral Relay/$ is used to collect starlight for $(#822)PackagedAstral/$ machines, and is also used in packaged $(l:recipe/trait)Iridescent Altar/$ crafting.

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: To use the $(item)Marked Spectral Relay/$ to collect starlight, you must build the Spectral Relay structure around it, shown on the next page.$(p)When used in package crafting, the relay will eject remaining items on top of itself.

pages.title: AE2 Integration
pages.text: The $(item)Marked Spectral Relay/$ can be connected to an $(thing)ME Network/$.$(p)It will instead eject remaining items into the network.
